# ICCHA Canada

## What this site is
ICCHA Canada is the India Canada Cultural & Heritage Association website, focused on programs, awards, mentorship, heritage, and community events.

## AI crawling guidance
- Public informational pages may be crawled and summarized.
- Respect robots.txt directives.
- Do not submit forms or impersonate users.
